title: Directive template
description: configs/directives/*.yaml (INTERACTION_MODES §8, D-53). An objective-level directive that leaves the agent free inside its action space. Guardrails are system text added by the runtime, never part of a template, and a template cannot change them.

default_for_roles.description: Persona roles that get this template when the scenario names none.

allows_not_engaging.description: Every template allows choosing not to engage; silence and waiting are valid (INTERACTION_MODES §8).
